mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen monotonically each of the last three weeks (-46.3 -> -45.0 -> -45.1 -> -43.0), indicating an entrenched recovery trend in discretionary mobility that should persist mechanically into the next four weeks absent a shock.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved from -46.3 to -43.0 over the snapshot window
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or lower than the mean over the last 28 days, breaking the observed three-week improving trend.

mechanism_narrative: Hong Kong is in a staged reopening regime following the third-wave outbreak; sustained recovery in PARKS (-72.3 to -65.4) and WORKPLACES (-38.6 to -36.4) reflects loosening public-gathering and office restrictions that will mechanically permit more retail footfall over the following two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved roughly 7 points and WORKPLACES roughly 2 points over the snapshot window
regime_hint: reopening phase following third-wave restriction relaxation
failure_condition: If PARKS or WORKPLACES mobility reverses and declines for two consecutive weeks while RETAIL_REC fails to rise, the policy-driven reopening mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL mobility falls below 11.5 (a threshold crossing from its current plateau around 12), this signals a behavioral shift toward reduced home-confinement caution, which should translate into a near-term (1-week) uptick in RETAIL_REC as people resume errands and leisure trips.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL has hovered between 11.7 and 13.3 over the last four weeks
regime_hint: steady state with gradual behavioral normalization
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL crosses below 11.5 but RETAIL_REC does not rise in the subsequent week, or RESIDENTIAL stays above threshold while RETAIL_REC rises anyway.

mechanism_narrative: Joint recovery in TRANSIT (-46.4 to -41.9) and WORKPLACES (-38.6 to -36.4) reflects compounding commuting-linked footfall: people traveling to workplaces generate incidental retail and dining visits en route, so simultaneous upward movement in both series should amplify RETAIL_REC gains over four weeks beyond what either series would predict alone.
evidence_refs: fact:both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improved concurrently across all four snapshot weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over 4 weeks even though both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES continue improving jointly, indicating no compounding interaction effect.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-September marks the start of the Hong Kong school term and post-summer-holiday routine normalization; this seasonal recurrence of structured weekday schedules should drive a steady four-week increase in RETAIL_REC as family and after-school shopping trips resume regardless of pandemic-specific policy shifts.
evidence_refs: fact:decision date 2020-09-15 falls within the typical Hong Kong school-term resumption window
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC and WORKPLACES both stagnate or decline over the next four weeks despite the seasonal school-term transition, indicating the seasonal effect is absent or dominated by other factors.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM mobility (currently stable around -18) suddenly drops more than 10 points in a week, this would indicate renewed panic-buying or a tightening-restriction signal, which should precede a contraction in RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks as households revert to essential-only trips.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM drops more than 10 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM has stayed within a narrow -17 to -19 band over the snapshot period
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM drops more than 10 points but RETAIL_REC continues to rise or stays flat over the next two weeks, rejecting the tightening-driven contraction mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: In a steady-state regime where no new policy shocks are visible, persistent elevated RESIDENTIAL mobility near 12 points above baseline reflects an entrenched cautious-behavior equilibrium that caps near-term RETAIL_REC recovery, producing flat-to-negative movement over the next week even as other series slowly improve.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL has remained between 11.7 and 13.3 for four consecutive weeks
regime_hint: steady-state cautious equilibrium with no new relaxation announcements
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises meaningfully over the next week despite RESIDENTIAL remaining elevated above 11.5, rejecting the behavioral-cap hypothesis.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous improvement in PARKS and TRANSIT over the last two weeks signals increased willingness to travel for leisure, and their joint continuation should interact to accelerate RETAIL_REC recovery over the next two weeks beyond the pace implied by RETAIL_REC's own recent trend.
candidate_trigger: PARKS and TRANSIT both improve for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose from -69.6 to -65.4 and TRANSIT from -44.6 to -41.9 over the last two weeks
failure_condition: PARKS and TRANSIT both continue improving for two weeks but RETAIL_REC growth does not exceed its prior trend pace, rejecting the interaction amplification effect.
